_comment: RLS rules dataset. QuickSight matches the logged-in user's UserName against the UserName column and restricts the main dataset to the matching tenant_id values. Built on reporting.v_rls_rules, which fans group-level grants out to member tenants. A P&L lead with group access transparently sees every tenant in that group; a restricted user sees only their listed tenant(s). Admins/full-access principals are simply absent from this table -> with GRANT_ACCESS policy they must be added explicitly, OR use a dedicated admin dataset without RLS (see docs/SECURITY_CHECKLIST.md).
Name: Suntech P&L - RLS Rules
